## Progress

Partial producer advance landed in [DivCurvePushforwardProducers.lean](/home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon/MainProjects/Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge/AlgebraicJacobian/Picard/DivCurvePushforwardProducers.lean:45):

- finite divisor support over arbitrary test bases;
- identity-flat pushforward over arbitrary test bases;
- finite-presentation pushforward over locally noetherian bases;
- finite support for line-bundle twists.

The module is umbrella-rooted in [AlgebraicJacobian.lean](/home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon/MainProjects/Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge/AlgebraicJacobian.lean:238). Commits: `03e7694f30`, `6c848f4fbf`, `4fcca19ae1`, `10e7a81de4`.

Verification passed:

- Focused module build: 8,735 jobs.
- AJC root build: 8,939 jobs.
- All four declarations use only `propext`, `Classical.choice`, and `Quot.sound`.
- Hgraph synced with four new `lean_ok` nodes.
- No blueprint edits, project axioms, `sorry`, or rational-point headline binder were introduced.

## Issues

This does not yet construct a Picard representer or discharge `fgaPicardRepresentability`. The honesty review classified it as genuine conditional substrate, with the flatness theorem primarily an API specialization and no substantive downstream representability consumer yet.

An affine rank specialization was rejected after `DivGrassmannianEmbedding` failed to produce an `.olean` during a bounded hour-long verification attempt. It was not committed.

## Next

The next concrete D2 producer is the post-pushforward epimorphism

```lean
Epi ((Modules.pushforward q).map (x.twistQuotientMap L))
```

needed by `grassmannianEval_epi`. Base-change epimorphy, arbitrary-base locally free rank, and pullback-natural Grassmannian classification remain after it. Task `ajc-kleiman-picard` remains running.
